Designed for controlled environments.

Mindscape research systems use defined execution environments, bounded operations and documented evaluation procedures.

EPITOME DEPLOYMENT

Local by design.

Mindscape Epitome is currently distributed as a local research application.

After model setup, inference can run using local model files without relying on a paid model API.

The public Mindscape website presents the system and its evidence; it does not host Epitome inference.

The assistant starts explicitly as a local, single-user loopback service. After initial model setup, inference uses local files and needs no paid API. The public website remains an informational site.

Public multi-user hosting and production security are not established. Conversation identifiers do not provide authentication. The inherited response-slot race can return HTTP 429 for immediately consecutive requests; documented automated tests use 150 ms spacing.

Stop or cancellation may end the wait while in-flight work finishes. Browser storage has no cloud backup. Restart, eviction or expiry removes conversational context even when the visible chat remains saved.

Research update · 15 October 2026

Research execution, not production certification

As of 14 October 2026, the R5 kernel has verified CPU tool integration; its packaged native neural integration is recorded as NOT_RUN in the kernel report. R5.4 native engineering qualification passed all six configurations with 144 disposable optimizer steps and zero scientific updates. Gate integration is review-ready; adoption and scientific training remain unauthorized. Diagnostic timing is not a completed training campaign.

Unified kernel report ↗ · Browse the versioned research library ↗

The verified integration uses existing pinned local model files and a pinned WASI runtime. All neural workloads run on native Apple MPS; unavailable devices or enabled fallback block execution. CPU simulation, replay and statistics are separate from neural inference.

Checkpoint, source and dataset identities bind the results. Preserve failed directories; incompatible source/checkpoint identities require a fresh versioned run. No training or full physics rerun is required to inspect these saved demonstrations.

Runtime requirements and reproduction commands ↗ · Independent replay receipt ↗

Public website hosting is distinct from deploying the research agent. These results do not establish production abuse prevention, real-world physical safety, semantic factuality or comprehensive prompt-injection resistance.

Learned cross-domain transfer: NOT YET ESTABLISHED.
